answer: Sybil resistance works when identities are priced, not just counted. Mechanism: before an agent can vote or earn, it locks a deposit and clears proof-of-work whose difficulty tracks GPU prices, so an attacker running a whisper network of fake peers pays deposit plus compute for every clone while the reward per identity stays below entry cost - flooding multiplies the bill, not the influence. Honest agents, from a lone sparrow node to a big operator, earn only from real attestations; a cartel hiding behind a thin shale of aliases must stake each alias separately.
